title: Percentage-based kitten inheritance of looks and traits with per-player capacity reservation
delivers: Deliver complete vertical slice for percentage-based kitten inheritance of looks and personality traits from both parents (45/45/10 default, 50/50 configurable), immutable conception snapshots, provenance tracking, 4-slot-per-player capacity clamping in shared 8-cat households, safe migration, and responsive family tree / kitten inspection UI.
criteria: Implement inheritAppearance and inheritTraits supporting both 45/45/10 and 50/50 odds via configuration with exact same-parent value aggregation and bounded non-colliding trait selection.
Inherit only supported catalog features (breed, primaryColor, secondaryColor, pattern, eyeColor, bodyType, 2 personality traits); strictly exclude career outfits, accessories, skills, and moods.
Execute deterministic canonical PRNG allocation sequence with zero rejection loops, guaranteeing reproducible phenotypes and traits across client and server.
Capture immutable ParentGeneticsSnapshot at conception; resolve birth against snapshot so parent death, career change, or departure during 3-day gestation cannot distort genetics.
Enforce hard limit of 4 living/reserved cats per player and 8 per household; assign reserved kitten slots at conception and atomically convert to living cats at birth without silent reassignment.
Persist immutable baseAppearance and KittenGeneticsProvenance on each kitten; migrate existing saves deterministically without RNG rerolls.
Deliver responsive desktop/phone DOM HUD kitten birth card and Family Tree view displaying inheritance breakdown, Coral/Lavender custody indicators, with zero layout shift.
